text:
Type: round opal glass flush ceiling lamp
Use: general ambient light close to the ceiling; hallway, bathroom, bedroom, corridor
Style: minimalist, contemporary, modern
Materials: white opal glass diffuser, white painted metal ceiling base
Colors: milky white, soft white
Shape: low round drum with a gently rounded rim and a soft step near the top, sits flush on the ceiling, compact, discreet and light
Feel: clean, calm, soft, unobtrusive
Goes with: white ceilings, pale walls, chrome or white fittings; simple modern or Scandinavian hallways and bathrooms

product.description: Light bulbs sold sparately. IKEA recommends LED bulb E14 400 lumen globe opal white (3 pcs). View more product information Gives a diffused light; good for spreading light into larger areas of a bathroom.
